summary: Full backend+frontend verification of Iteration 23 (Underworld gating, Crime fail/bust risk profiles, Stock+Crypto markets, Admin tuning). Backend pytest: 15/15 PASS. Frontend: all 8 review items verified on live URL.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still ~3065 lines — recommend splitting market/underworld/admin routers into modules (existing minor code hygiene issue, not blocking).
MarketPanel.jsx nicely reuses one component with kind='stock'|'crypto' — DRY, testable via kind-holdings-value / asset-<id> / buy-<id> / sell-<id> / position-<id>.
Fail vs Bust separation on illegal-actions is clear: response includes fail_chance + bust_risk per action; UI renders separate fail-profile-<id> and bust-profile-<id> panels — matches spec exactly.
/api/market/stocks returns bare list (no wrapper) while /api/market/crypto returns {access, assets}. Slight shape inconsistency but not a bug; frontend handles both.
Admin tuning drift/volatility keys (stock_drift, stock_volatility, crypto_drift, crypto_volatility) persist correctly via PUT /api/admin/config — verified via read-mutate-read round-trip.
Mara's crypto buy correctly returns 403 (crypto locked for players without trusted shady contact) — gating enforced at API level, not just UI.
